messages:
devon: Bringing up ap-southeast-2 GPU cluster next week. Need security baseline for new cluster: IAM roles, secrets, KMS/HSM integration, policy checks. Anyone owning handoff runbook?
ana: I can own the baseline. Quick list: IAM least-priv roles, instance profiles, KMS key per-region with HSM protection, secrets in Secret Manager with VPC-SC, VPC peering egress rules, host disk encryption, audit logs to secure bucket + retention, policy tests + terraform check.
ben: Also cost notes: reserved capacity vs burst, tag infra for cost center, enforce quotas on GPUs via quota controller. We'll need an estimate of baseline token throughput for autoscaler shaping.
cho: Ran validations on staging yesterday. Commands I used:
```
aws iam get-role --role-name redwood-gpu-node-role
gcloud kms keys versions list --key redwood-region-key
kubectl get secrets -n infra
```
All returned expected states except KMS key policy missing `kms:Encrypt` for service-account SA_crossregion.
devon: @cho can you paste the failing policy snippet?
cho: Snippet:
```
{ "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "Service": "compute.googleapis.com" }, "Action": [ "kms:Encrypt" ] } ] }
```
Missing the SA principal and Organization restriction.
ana: Fix is: add principal for `serviceAccount:infra-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and condition `StringEquals: { 'kms:requesterOrg': 'org/12345' }`. I'll patch in staging and re-run.
deploy-bot: deploy status: patched kms policy in staging (run id: d-9032). CI: policy-check/infra passed.
ben: :thumbsup: Reminder: secrets rotation policy must be 30d for access keys and 90d for app creds. Document in runbook under 'Secrets & KMS' and attach rotation playbook.
nana: Checklist I'm adding to runbook (short):
- IAM: roles + SFN least-priv
- KMS/HSM: multi-region key, rotation, binding, audit
- Secrets: Secret Manager + VPC-SC + rotation
- Network: private egress, no 0.0.0.0/0 inbound, VPC endpoints for secrets/kms
- Nodes: COS image baseline, disk encryption, signed images
- Logging: audit logs -> secure-bucket, retention 1y
- Policy tests: terraform plan + conftest + aws/google policy scan
- Cost tags: `cost-center`,`env`,`team`
devon: Nice. For handoff to oncall/ops, add runbook steps: smoke tests, GPU job submit, perf baseline metrics (p95 latency, tokens/s), fallback routing to eu-west if capacity low.
cho: Also add a quick diagnostic script to the repo: `scripts/cluster-health.sh` that checks IAM, KMS, secrets, node status, GPU allocatable.
ben: Budget guardrail: set alert at 80% committed usage and daily spend cap notify. Ops: who will own oncall for first 72h post-create? @ana?
nana: I'll cover first 72h. @devon pls add me to the launch calendar and grant `oncall` tag in pagerduty.
devon: Done. Added ana to PD, calendar invite to eng-infra-launch-ap-sg. Final ask: security signoff from sec team. @maria-sec — can you review once runbook PR is up?
maria-sec: On it. I'll run through the checklist and post any gating items by EOD tomorrow.
